authority_hierarchy.rule: Temporal neighbors control motion and contacts only and never replace design or proportion authority.

identity_lock.head_face: Preserve head width, rounded face, eye spacing and facial identity.
identity_lock.proportions: Preserve body volume, dress width, leg thickness, shoe size, scale and margins.
identity_lock.hair_material: Preserve ash-blonde luminance and restrained highlights without stripes, grain or brightening.
identity_lock.accessory_topology: One fixed-side satchel, one connected strap and exactly one intact rabbit.
identity_lock.rendering: Preserve original outline, shading, camera, light and material frequency.

action_contract.forbidden_changes: identity, proportion, topology, palette, material, camera, crop, shadow and scenery
